name: Tiza Battleforge
summary: In Ironforge, Tiza Battleforge guides young paladins through the ways of the Holy Light. She teaches virtue, charity, and self-sacrifice, then tests initiates before they may wield its gift of resurrection.

sections.title: Mentor of the Mystic Ward
sections.body:
Tiza Battleforge guides paladins in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. Tutors across the Alliance send initiates to her for deeper study of the Light. Brandur Ironhammer sends them from Ironforge, Azar Stronghammer from Dun Morogh, and Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker from Stormwind.

Tiza teaches that the Holy Light asks more than skill in battle. Its servants must offer humble service, show compassion, and stand firm against the Scourge and other threats.

sections.title: The Trials of Divinity
sections.body:
Tiza gives young paladins the Tome of Divinity to study. Then she sends them to offer charity, beginning with those in humble need, such as John Turner. Next, she tests their faith and skill by asking them to aid her husband, Muiredon Battleforge, against the Dark Iron dwarves.

Those who pass these trials and use the Symbol of Life to revive fallen allies earn Tiza's trust. Then they may wield the sacred art of resurrection.

faq.answer: Tiza Battleforge is a dwarven paladin of the Knights of the Silver Hand. In Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries, she mentors paladins seeking a deeper bond with the Holy Light.

faq.q: Where can I find Tiza Battleforge?
faq.answer: Tiza is in the Hall of Mysteries, in Ironforge's Mystic Ward, where spiritual and arcane learning are taught.

faq.q: What is the Tome of Divinity she gives to paladins?
faq.answer: The Tome of Divinity is a sacred text of the Holy Light's teachings and virtues. Tiza gives it to paladins to study before their trials of charity, courage, and mercy.

faq.q: Why does Tiza send paladins to help her husband Muiredon?
faq.answer: Tiza sends paladins to aid her husband, Muiredon Battleforge, against Dark Iron dwarves while he assists his companion Narm Faulk. The danger tests their bravery and readiness to use the Symbol of Life to revive fallen comrades.

faq.q: What ability does Tiza teach worthy paladins?
faq.answer: After worthy paladins complete her charity trials and rescue Muiredon's fallen comrade, Tiza teaches them Redemption, the sacred rite of resurrection.

faq.q: What is her connection to Brandur Ironhammer?
faq.answer: Brandur Ironhammer is a fellow dwarven paladin trainer in Ironforge's Hall of Mysteries. Tiza once told him his jealousy was a spiritual weakness, and Brandur vowed to overcome it.

angles.text: As a dwarven paladin, you face Tiza Battleforge's tests through the Tome of Divinity. Those who prove worthy may learn to resurrect fallen allies.
Tiza shows how deeply the Holy Light and the Silver Hand are rooted in dwarven culture. She guides Khaz Modan's defenders against threats such as the Dark Iron clan.
Tiza works with mentors from Stormwind to Kharanos to uphold shared standards of virtue and martial readiness across Alliance lands.
